summary.en: OVER, PARTITION BY, ROW_NUMBER, RANK, SUM() OVER, LAG

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
SELECT
  name,
  salary,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank
FROM employees
ORDER BY salary_rank;

prompt.vi: Xếp hạng nhân viên theo lương giảm dần bằng RANK(): trả về name, salary và cột thứ ba là hạng. (Son và Quynh cùng lương 2300 nên cùng hạng 6.)
prompt.en: Rank employees by salary descending with RANK(): return name, salary and a third column holding the rank. (Son and Quynh share a 2300 salary so they share rank 6.)

hint.vi: RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank
hint.en: RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank

prompt.vi: Xếp hạng lương TRONG TỪNG phòng ban: trả về name, department_id và hạng (dùng PARTITION BY department_id). Bỏ qua nhân viên không có phòng ban.
prompt.en: Rank salaries WITHIN each department: return name, department_id and the rank (use PARTITION BY department_id). Skip employees without a department.

hint.vi: RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) ... WHERE department_id IS NOT NULL
hint.en: RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) ... WHERE department_id IS NOT NULL

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT name, department_id FROM employees WHERE department_id IS NOT NULL;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
SELECT name, department_id,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS dept_rank
FROM employees
WHERE department_id IS NOT NULL;
